task: Parse an AWS CloudWatch log entry and extract the timestamp, log level, and message using a regular expression
solution_criteria: The regex must correctly capture three groups: (1) ISO 8601 timestamp, (2) log level (INFO, ERROR, WARN, DEBUG), and (3) the remaining message text. Should handle variable whitespace.

task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS S3 bucket name and object key, then returns a properly formatted S3 URI (s3://bucket/key)
solution_criteria: Function must accept bucket name and object key as parameters, validate that inputs are non-empty strings, and return a valid S3 URI string in the format s3://bucket/key

task: Create a JSON configuration object for an AWS Lambda function that specifies runtime, timeout, memory allocation, and environment variables for a Python 3.11 function
solution_criteria: JSON must include valid keys for runtime (python3.11), timeout (in seconds), memory size (128-10240 MB), and at least two sample environment variables. Must be valid JSON syntax.
